result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom of the feed is partially obscured by the tab bar.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards/text containers expand or ellipsize consistently with full names visible on tap.

issues.description: The horizontal category filter row is clipped on the right; the next chip is only partially visible with no clear affordance that the list scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add peek padding, a fade edge, or a clearer scroll indicator so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza) is cut off by the fixed bottom tab bar, so part of the content is hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery fee on the Green Bowl Poké card shows '€0.90 delivery', which may be unintended or inconsistent with the free-delivery promo messaging nearby.
issues.suggestion: Verify pricing copy and align promo/fee display so users are not confused by conflicting delivery costs.
